corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Cardigan absorbs reachable lower locks without retreat. Two physicians sustain shared eastern recipients. Steward must actually kill artillery before his4280 withdrawal.
Midnight destroys eastern restraint3; Steward eventually destroys western restraint1. Neither ordinary blocking nor ordinary attacks may target the civilian.

Cardigan contains lower officers. Steward later destroys eastern restraint4; Midnight later destroys western restraint2. The civilian remains exposed to artillery while restrained east, so its actual damage budget is mandatory.
Fang holds upper central; Midnight supplies available damage, followed by returning Steward. Armor21 must be removed before runner occupancy exceeds Fang's two blocks.
Friston holds lower central; Hibiscus heals him; Midnight and returning Steward clear armor. Actual blocking of the final armor is required.
Midnight holds upper outer without medical coverage. His HP and time spent on personal blocks bound central assistance.
Cardigan permanently holds lower outer, self-heals and receives Ansel recovery. Three-block capacity is finite; the fourth simultaneous occupant invalidates containment.

formation_structure.artillery_damage_budget: An unchanged first hit near2161 followed by 45 artillery-directed attacks at48-frame spacing would reach its 45th hit near4273. The 36 ordinary and9 enhanced-hit budget is13227.21 damage. Actual contact, target choice and survival must establish this; deployment2131 alone does not.
formation_structure.death_accounting: No death is required. An operator death may have useful prior contribution, but its lost blocking, released enemies, zero refund and cooldown must be charged. This fixed plan contains no unbudgeted replacement after death.

economy.failure_interpretation: Missing Fang grants mean failed survival or continuous deployment. They are not arithmetic corrections.
economy.redeployment_basis: Inspected model and supplied prior plan use unchanged deployment costs. Every scheduled same-ID return exceeds 2100 frames.
economy.refund_basis: Current simulator uses floor(0.5 * deployment_cost); death returns zero. Steward withdrawals return 9 each; Midnight withdrawal returns 8.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: Fixed actions only. Conditions are falsification assertions, not conditional execution, automatic delays or permission to ignore failed actions.
formation_structure.fusion_tradeoff: Cardigan has 2130 HP, 475 DEF, three blocks and an instantaneous 852-HP self-heal. She takes 525 physical damage from a 1000-ATK shell. She does not stop attacking to heal, but has low single-target output and cannot destroy adjacent roadblocks.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Hibiscus [2,6] UP covers Fang, Friston, Ansel and eastern Steward. Ansel [5,6] UP covers Cardigan, himself and eastern Steward. Neither covers Midnight. Eastern Steward and Ansel remain one tile apart and therefore share 1.2-radius shells; this burden is retained explicitly, not declared solved by rotation.
formation_structure.western_clearance: Steward clears roadblock1; redeployed Midnight clears roadblock2. Cardigan receives no fictitious ranged device-clearance duty.

tactical_thesis: Test a seven-ID role-fusion structure: Cardigan permanently combines lower-outer containment, artillery absorption and self-recovery, replacing both Melantha and Spot. Preserve two physicians and Steward's artillery-to-central rotation. Transfer eastern lower-roadblock clearance to Steward after combat. This removes the failed permanent-Melantha survival dependency and avoids replacement into a locked shell, but does not establish a WIN: protected-target exposure, shared medical load and upper-central armor clearance remain decisive unverified conditions.
